entries.value: My head... where am I? This bed... these walls...
Three months? My wristband says I have been here three months. I remember nothing.
I have to get out of here. First, I need to know who I am.
Wristband: Kian Moradi — inpatient ward, bed 7.
Three months admitted. And I can barely remember my own name.
An admission form... signed in my own handwriting. Did I ask to come here?
Admission date: three months ago. The signature... it is exactly my handwriting.
This is impossible. I never signed anything like this... did I?
...maybe I really did ask for it.
But the handwriting... it is exactly mine. How is that possible?
If I asked for this myself, what did I want to forget?
Nurse's note: "Emergency generator — switch order: second, first, third. Once power is back, the service elevator runs too."
So Sara... the nurse who wrote this — is she still here?
That voice... Leila? Who are you? How do you know my name?
The service elevator opened. The basement... it is not on the hospital map.
Chapter 1 complete — "Awakening". The story continues in Chapter 2.
The switch order is written in the nurse's note.
Wrong order — the lights flickered and everything reset.
Power is back. The lights are on.
